resources.string: Choose who can reach you, and when. Everyone else rings as usual.
Filtering is temporarily paused while your changes are saved.
All calls are allowed. Your settings stay here.
Enabled numbers are allowed during your windows and filtered outside them.
Complete setup below. All calls are allowed while a required permission is missing.
Android needs to choose unconnected as its call screening app. Contacts permission lets Android include saved callers; the app never reads your address book.
Call screening is unavailable on this device.
If Android no longer asks, enable Contacts in app settings. Without both permissions, filtering stays paused.
Only enabled numbers in this list follow the shared schedule.
Your list is empty. Add a number to start; no calls are filtered yet.
For national numbers, choose their country (IT, GB, US…). International numbers begin with + and a country code.
Enter a valid full phone number and a supported two-letter region. Extensions and short codes are not supported.
This number is already in your list.
This number will ring normally after it is removed.
One weekly schedule for all enabled numbers. Times follow the current device time zone: %1$s.
No allowed hours. When active, enabled numbers are filtered all week.
Choose at least one day and different start and end times.
Start is included; end is excluded. An end time earlier than the start continues into the next day.
Without allowed hours, every enabled number will be filtered whenever unconnected is active. Other callers are still allowed.
Calls from enabled numbers will only be allowed in the remaining windows.

Forwarded calls may show the original caller, not your office number. Only the number Android presents can be matched. Hidden, ambiguous and unlisted callers are always allowed.

Quiet blocking and notification suppression depend on Android and your phone manufacturer. Android may keep blocked calls in its call log. Test with someone you trust before relying on filtering.

Your settings stay on this phone. No account, Internet, analytics or call recording. Deactivate at any time or uninstall normally.
Could not save changes. Filtering is paused for this app session. Previously saved settings may return after restart. Retry saving or remove the screening role in system settings.
Saved settings could not be read safely. All calls are allowed. Reset only if you want to discard these settings and start again.
This removes your saved numbers and hours. Filtering starts off.
Android could not open this setting.
A settings update paused filtering. Save a change or deactivate to recover. Previously saved settings may return after the app restarts.
